NAVIGATION

Lake Washington DPV Planner

Plan the route. Know the distance.

What it is

A planning tool for connecting Lake Washington wrecks and laying out scooter routes before getting in the water.

Map the route between wrecks, place waypoints, and work through distances and bearings. This is where route planning meets the practical questions of a DPV dive.

Open Lake Washington DPV Planner ↗
Use alongside current site information, your own gas and bailout planning, and independent navigation. A planned route is not a guarantee of underwater position.
